Name: JP's Shin HD Portraits Framework - RE Portraiture
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=6][b][i][u]Shin HD Portraits[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]Now you can create Content Packs and distribute your creations efficiently and easily, with multiple customization options![/size][/color][/i][/b]


[size=4]This project has risen like a phoenix from the ashes to give users greater ease in creating and setting up their personalized portraits, as well as being able to share them with other users through [color=#00ffff][b]Content Packs[/b][/color]!
Enjoy the Vanilla Plus experience, just you, the dialog box, and the personalized portrait you downloaded, inside that beautiful frame.[/size]


[size=4][i]The mod has several features for both PC and mobile versions that will give you a better experience with various portraits![/i][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]PC:[/b][/size][/color]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qMv0vpXD/NPCShowcase.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=3]You can switch between several portraits of mods that you have installed and that change the portrait of the same NPC using the [color=#00ff00][b]“P” key (by default, this can be changed in GMCM).[/b][/color][/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=3]You can set or unset the portraits from the mod you like for a specific NPC (for example, for Abigail you can use the portraits from Mod A and for Haley the portraits from Mod B) using the [b][color=#00ff00]“I” key (by default, this can be changed in GMCM).[/color][/b][/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=3]You can increase the size of the portraits for better definition using the [color=#00ff00][b]“O” key (by default, this can be changed in GMCM).[/b][/color][/size][/font][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

MOBILE:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9FQVQctZ/NPCShowcase1.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]﻿Switch between portraits [b][color=#00ff00]by tapping the portrait once.[/color][/b][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Set or unset the portraits [color=#00ff00][b]by quickly double-tapping the portrait.[/b][/color][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]Increase the size of portraits [color=#00ff00][b]by quickly tapping the portrait three times.[/b][/color][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]It is compatible with any portrait, character, vendor portrait, Custom NPC, etc... [/i][/size][/color][color=#00ff00][size=5][i]For example, the “They Deserve It Too” mod adds new portraits to vendors who don't have one. [/i][/size][/color]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][u]How do I create my Content Pack?[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00]In the downloads[/color][/b], I will leave a [b][i][color=#ffff00]Content Template[/color][/i][/b] with which you will learn how to configure your portraits to be used in the game, as well as unique customizations such as using portraits in different situations (at the beach, on a certain day, in certain weather, at a festival, etc.). There you will find useful information for building your own CP, permitted values, conditions, tokens, etc., and everything you need to get your portraits up and running. [/size][/font]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][font=Georgia][b][u]Still need more examples? Check out my other mods for Shin:[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18127]Multiple NPC[/url][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41552]One NPC[/url][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Do you have Portraiture portraits without a Content.json file?[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][b][size=5][font=Georgia][i][color=#00ff00]Add them to the mod's Portraits folder and enjoy them in-game without any extra settings or a Content.json file![/color][/i][/font][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]This mod was created to replace Portraiture, which is outdated, and HD Portraits, which has not worked in 1.6 for some time.[/i][/size][/color]


[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.

[color=#00ffff]If you wish, you can also translate the Content Template instructions to help people in your language create their CP.[/color]
